Root cause of the 'monster stands still': the old stuck-check required 'path NOT finished', but when the NavMesh finds no path to a random target it reports 'destination reached' -> the check never fired and the same bad target was kept forever. Now: if the monster SHOULD be moving but isn't, escalate: (1) re-send MoveTo, (2) pick another target, (3) go near the player (always on the NavMesh), (4) hard reset to Patrol.
SMARTER PATROL: hotspots the monster already walked through (and found nothing) lose weight, so it moves on to the next-most-likely spot instead of looping on one.
